Name: cantibleChaos's BFAV Camels for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from cantibleChaos, I have converted their BFAV Camels (found at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17933) to ContentPatcher to work on SDV 1.6. Credit to cantibleChaos for the original mod

Camels live in Barns and produce hump fat, and camel milk that can be turned into a cheese.

Enjoy!
